objective: Preallocate new inverted-index posting lists for their first posting entry.

tasks.title: Preallocate inverted-index posting lists
tasks.result: InvertedIndex now creates new term posting lists with capacity for the immediately inserted first posting.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The posting list capacity is 1 because add_document immediately pushes the first (doc_id, frequency) entry for a newly-created term.
The optimization only changes initial Vec allocation for new terms; tokenization, BM25 scoring, persistence, and FTS SQL behavior are unchanged.
